selector.rationale: The patient's symptoms, including progressive dysarthria, dysphagia, cognitive impairment, vertical gaze palsy, tongue atrophy, and pyramidal signs, along with the genetic testing showing a heterozygous pathogenic variant of the TBK1 gene, are most consistent with Frontotemporal dementia and parkinsonism-17.

rejected.label: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis
rejected.why: While the patient has some symptoms consistent with ALS, such as tongue atrophy, the overall clinical presentation and genetic findings are more supportive of Frontotemporal dementia and parkinsonism-17.
